default_mode: Python 3.10+, standard library only: file integrity, exact polynomial elimination/positivity certificates, all 18 finite discriminants, printed proof tables and mathematical corruption controls. Determinant coefficient reconstructions are NOT rerun.
full_mode: Default plus all eight byte-preserved source checkers, including the prerequisite reduction, two independent coefficient methods and final proof tables. Installed SymPy required; tested with Python 3.12.14 and SymPy 1.14.0. Missing SymPy is a hard failure.
scope: Every binary 5-by-5 mask with four full rows and a nonempty remaining row; distinct real offsets and distinct nonnegative integer exponents. No arbitrary five-row mask or general colored conclusion.
validation: Outer MANIFEST.json and checks/ hold staged and fresh extracted normal/optimized results and explicit dependency/corruption tests.
writes: All source checker output goes into a temporary copy; the frozen payload is never modified.
